question: Why would eleven-foldness and nine-selfhood not hold for the mother?
premises: Thus in the arising of the interval between mantras and their lords
inference: In the interval where mantras and their lords arise, neither eleven-foldness nor nine-selfhood applies.
uncertainties: mātā may be a vocative address or part of a compound
plain_english: Mother, that eleven-foldness would not be, nor nine-selfhood; thus it is in the arising of the interval between the mantras and their lords.
